clips.title: The story
paras: During the Feast of Winter Veil, the performer portraying Greatfather Winter in Ironforge grows tired and asks passersby for a seasonal treat. Bringing him freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk earns a festive reward and his warm gratitude.

While Winter Veil has its roots in ancient titan lore and dwarven myths of an immortal figure cloaked in winter's chill, modern festivities rely heavily on the commercial sponsorship of Smokywood Pastures. Stationed by the holiday tree in the Commons of Ironforge, an ordinary dwarf spends grueling hours suited up as Greatfather Winter, fielding holiday wishes from citizens and eager children alike.

After listening to requests for gifts all day, the resident Greatfather Winter inevitably develops a hearty appetite of his own. Rather than asking for something extravagant, he requests a simple comfort: five freshly baked gingerbread cookies made with holiday spices and an ice cold milk to wash them down. The trade offers a moment of relief to an exhausted festival worker and spreads goodwill throughout the snowy capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey, can you do Greatfather Winter a favor, um, little kid?

Not to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Greatfather Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself. Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot. Think you could be a friend to the Greatfather and fetch some for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: All this talk of treats has given me a hankering for some myself. Mmmm... Gingerbread cookies and milk...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're quite the helper to ol' Greatfather Winter there, friend. Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.
Here's a little something... You know, for the effort.
